# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are maintained for the current `main` branch and the latest published release.
Older releases may not receive security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:

https://github.com/Sargon-17-Green/Pastafarian-Calendar-Seer/security/advisories/new

Include the affected version or commit, impact, and enough reproduction detail to investigate safely.

Do not report secrets, credentials, tokens, or other sensitive vulnerability details in a public issue or pull request.
If a credential you control has been exposed, revoke or rotate it promptly and use the private reporting channel above.
